# `storage/SystemFS.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/SystemFS.js`

SystemFS.js — read-only virtual filesystem for the compiled-in OS. The engine, Plauna shell, editor, AGI runtime and the built-in apps are packaged directly into the OS bundle (ES modules compiled into the runtime). They are NOT stored in OPFS or IndexedDB, so they can never be edited, moved, or deleted — they are part of the system image. This driver surfaces them as a browsable, read-only tree mounted at `/system` so the Files app can SHOW where they live and clearly mark them immutable, while user/installed content (OPFS + IndexedDB) stays fully writable. Every entry returned carries `{ system: true, readOnly: true }` so the UI and the StorageManager guards can treat it as immutable. All methods are async to match the other storage drivers.
